name: Ako Dhong
kicker: Ede longhouses on the north edge
summary: Walk the Ede longhouses at Buon Ako Dhong, about 2 km north of the center in Tan Loi. The houses are family homes, so ask before you step inside. Make it a quiet walk between the other stops, and skip it if you only want a ticketed building.
getThere: About 2 km north, in Tan Loi, by taxi or motorbike
heroCaption: A longhouse on stilts, with a newer house beside it
body: Buon Ako Dhong is in Tan Loi, about 2 km north of the center. Walk the lane of Ede longhouses. In 2019 the village still had 34 of them. Many are family homes, and a newer house often sits behind the old one, so ask before you go inside.

The walk is the houses and the garden paths, including the thatched shelters over the water. A cafe along the lane is one stop, not the whole village. Come for the longhouses, and leave the timed museums for another hour.

gettingThere: The village is in Tan Loi, about 2 km north of the center. Take a taxi, Grab, or a motorbike. The ride time is Check on arrival.
